name: Custom Wooden Freestanding Display Set
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a warm, sturdy, and elegant display finish.
    - Features a custom wooden freestanding display set designed for both decorative presentation and personalized keepsake use.
    - Wooden thickness: 5mm, providing a solid and durable structure for long-term display.
    - Includes a wooden box and custom freestanding pieces, creating a coordinated and meaningful gift set.
    - The box is neatly constructed with interlocking wooden panels for a stable and refined handcrafted look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Wooden box size:
                   +) Length: 9 in ~ 22.86 cm
                   +) Width: 4 in ~ 10.16 cm
                   +) Height: 2.29 in ~ 5.82 cm
    - Custom piece size: 3.17 x 8.11 in ~ 8.05 x 20.60 cm
    - The box can hold up to 8 custom pieces
    📌 Note:  The shape of the box is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.  The product dimensions of the wooden piece may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports double-sided printing on all sides of the box and wooden piece.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized decorative display set and a keepsake storage box.
    - Designed to hold and organize up to 8 custom freestanding pieces neatly inside the wooden box.
    - Suitable for displaying names, floral pieces, themed inserts, or personalized decorative elements.
    - The finished product can be placed on desks, shelves, countertops, display tables, or memory corners.
    - Perfect for home décor, celebration displays, memorial keepsakes, and meaningful personalized gifts.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, Mother’s Day, memorial occasions, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for flower lovers, personalized keepsake gifts, and decorative display collections.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving names, heartfelt messages, and meaningful memories in a unique format.
    - Great for home décor, desk display, shelf decoration, and commemorative gift giving.
    - Adds a warm, creative, and memorable touch to any personal space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Wooden Freestanding Display Set

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
